title: Analista de Dados
description:
A Engesoftware está em busca de um Analista de Dados para compor o seu time!

Essa vaga inclui Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD


Benefícios:

  • Apoio jurídico, caso precise;
  • Apoio nutricional, para uma alimentação mais saudável;
  • Apoio financeiro, para planejar finanças pessoais ou investimento a longo prazo;
  • Apoio social, orientação para momentos pessoais difíceis;
  • Apoio psicológico, para aquecer a mente e o coração;
  • Descontos exclusivos com instituições como Descontos exclusivos com instituições como (SENAI, SESC, Anhanguera, Estácio, IESB, Cruzeiro do Sul, Unifametro e Rockfeller);
  • Plano Enge Pets, para que seu pet tenha o melhor cuidado;
  • Parceria com o Bali Park, um espaço de lazer e entretenimento;
  • VA/VR;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico (Bradesco);
  • Seguro de vida (Santander Zurich);


Requisitos Necessários:

  • Ensino superior concluído em TI ou pós na área;
  • Conhecimento com as seguintes tecnologias: codificação de scripts de consulta a dados (SQL-like), Criação de consultas em bancos de dados, Noções de estatísticas;



Requisitos Desejavéis:

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos na área.


Estamos em busca de um profissional que queira somar com o nosso time e crescer com a gente!

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Java / AI-Enabled)

Rocket Financial builds innovative fintech products that improve how money moves globally. We work across multiple high-impact fintech projects , tackling complex problems in payments, infrastructure, and financial services.


We are a U.S.-based company hiring an international contractor located in Brazil . This role will work closely with a distributed team, including Brazil and Canada based engineers.


We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is primarily backend-focused but comfortable contributing to the frontend when needed. You’ll play a key role in shaping systems, building scalable applications, and leveraging AI tools to move faster and smarter.


WHY JOIN US

  • Fast-paced startup environment with high impact and real ownership
  • 100% fully remote role
  • Work with a U.S.-based company building cutting-edge fintech products
  • Flexible schedule with alignment to East Coast hours
  • Collaborative, international team with strong engineering talent
  • Opportunity to work with modern technologies and AI-driven development


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build and scale Java-based backend systems and microservices
  • Contribute to frontend features (React or similar) when needed
  • Design robust, scalable applications and system architectures
  • Use AI tools (Claude, Codex, etc.) to accelerate development and problem-solving
  • Write and refine effective AI prompts for engineering workflows
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Design to deliver impactful features
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and agile processes
  • Debug and resolve production issues and performance challenges


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience (strong backend focus in Java)
  • Experience with Spring, microservices, and REST APIs
  • Comfortable working across the stack (React/TypeScript or similar )
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude, Codex, etc.)
  • Strong system design and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Docker, CI/CD, and AWS
  • Able to thrive in a fast-moving environment and adapt quickly

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior | Databricks e Inglês Avançado
description:
Muito prazer, somos a United Hub Digital, uma consultoria de tecnologia nearshore que combina inovação, excelência técnica e agilidade para transformar negócios

Na UHub, somos impulsionados pelo propósito de liderar a transformação digital com excelência e agilidade. A flexibilidade é uma das nossas marcas registradas. Atuamos com diferentes modelos e formatos de time, adaptando-nos ao contexto de cada cliente. Nosso diferencial está em entregar soluções de ponta com uma equipe enxuta, eficiente e com mentalidade de dono.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

Estamos procurando um Senior Databricks Engineer com experiência na construção de pipelines e desenvolvimento de processos ETL no Databricks para agregar ao nosso Databricks CoE . Nesta função, você desempenhará um papel essencial na interseção entre negócios e tecnologia, combinando profundo conhecimento técnico com a capacidade de alinhar soluções tecnológicas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

O Que Estamos Buscando

  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente;
  • 5+ anos de experiência com manipulação e engenharia de dados
  • 5+ anos com processos ETL
  • 3+ anos de experiência com Databricks
  • 3+ anos de experiência com Azure
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Excelente comunicação e colaboração em equipe
  • Esta função pode gerar oportunidades de viagens domésticas e/ou internacionais;

Será Um Diferencial Se Você

  • Vivência em projetos internacionais e equipes multiculturais
  • Experiência com Power BI e integração entre engenharia e BI
  • Curiosidade e desejo de se envolver em diferentes etapas do ciclo de dados (desde ingestão até visualização)

Onde Você Vai Trabalhar

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota

Modalidade De Contratação

  • CLT ou PJ.

title: Back End Developer
description:
About the Role

StaffingAbroad is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer to join a #1 US-based FinTech & Crypto company . This role is ideal for a highly skilled backend developer who excels in C#/.NET and has a strong focus on writing maintainable, scalable, and secure code . You will play a key role in shaping architecture, ensuring system performance, and embedding best practices while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

This is a 100% remote, full-time role Salary $5.000USD to $6.000 USD

English C1 required


What You Will Do

  • Develop and Maintain Applications : Build, enhance, and maintain secure, scalable backend services using C#/.NET and integrate with APIs like Plaid, Dwolla, and Treasury Prime.
  • Shape System Architecture : Contribute to system design, ensuring performance, scalability, and security across FinTech applications.
  • Write Quality Code : Implement and test maintainable, well-documented code, with a focus on automation and software best practices.
  • Support Production Systems : Monitor and troubleshoot production applications to ensure high availability and quick issue resolution.
  • Collaborate Across Teams : Work closely with front-end, QA, product, and IT teams, while mentoring junior engineers.
  • Focus on Security and Compliance : Embed security best practices and maintain compliance with FinTech regulations.


What You Will Need

  • Strong Technical Expertise :
  • Solid foundation in design patterns, software development best practices, and principles like SOLID and Clean Code.
  • Proficiency in C#/.NET, ASP.NET MVC/WebAPI, and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs).
  • Strong understanding of MSSQL database design and optimization.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Experience with modern front-end and server-side technologies such as Node.js and React.
  • Commitment to Software Quality :
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and ensuring code coverage.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly in Azure DevOps.
  • Proficient in version control systems, especially Git.
  • Experience and Education :
  • 6+ years of back-end software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
  • Collaboration and Communication :
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.
  • Enthusiasm for contributing to a collaborative, dynamic team environment.
  • Cultural Fit :
  • Passion for innovation, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Alignment with a culture that prioritizes excellence in FinTech and Crypto solutions.


Plusses Include

  • Experience with iDesign architecture methodology .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, including their tools and services.

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.

title: Senior Web Developer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in WordPress and HubSpot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.


This is not a classic WordPress role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern JavaScript and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.


If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,

brittle WordPress builds, you'll fit right in.


Key Responsibilities

Website Development

  • Design and build production-grade marketing websites in WordPress (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and HubSpot CMS (HubL templating, modules, themes).
  • Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate
  • prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.
  • Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).
  • Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.


API Integrations & Automation Hooks

  • Integrate websites with HubSpot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.
  • Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.
  • Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).


Quality, Performance & SEO

  • Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.
  • Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, HubSpot tracking, server-side events where needed).
  • Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.


Collaboration

  • Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.
  • Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/GitHub), and documentation.
  • Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.


Required Skills

Technical

  • 3+ years building production websites in WordPress (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).
  • Strong HubSpot CMS experience (HubL, modules, themes, forms, smart content).
  • Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.
  • Comfortable in Git/GitHub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.


Modern Web Skills

  • Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).
  • Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).
  • Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).
  • Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).


Bonus Experience

(Not required, but highly valuable)

  • Webflow development experience.
  • Headless WordPress or HubSpot setups (Next.js + WP/HubSpot APIs).
  • Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.
  • Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.
  • E-commerce experience (WooCommerce, Shopify).
  • Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.


Soft Skills

  • Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.
  • Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.
  • Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.
  • Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.


What Success Looks Like

  • In the first 60–90 days, you will:
  • Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.
  • Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).
  • Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (HubSpot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.
  • Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado]
description:
Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery . Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents ), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We're seeking a skilled Portuguese (Brazil) Voice Actor to bring characters and stories to life across various domains, using their voice to capture the right emotion, personality, and tone.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Record voice-overs from a professional home studio or in-studio sessions
  • Perform lines with clarity, emotion, and appropriate pacing
  • Interpret scripts and take creative direction
  • Revise performances based on feedback
  • Deliver high-quality audio files on time and in the correct format


Requirements:

  • Previous voice acting experience
  • Strong vocal control and versatility
  • Clear speech and emotional range
  • Access to high-quality recording equipment (for remote roles)
  • Ability to follow direction and meet deadlines


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with dubbing, ADR, or localization
  • Demo reel showcasing a variety of voice styles
  • Background in acting or performing arts
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • This is a flexible agreement , not a full-time or part-time employment position.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisting based on qualifications and relevant professional experience.
  • Shortlisted candidates will undergo a delivery review, after which they will be ready to start!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Analista de dados
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados que vá além de números — alguém capaz de transformar dados em insights estratégicos e apoiar decisões que impactam diretamente o crescimento do negócio.

Se você tem olhar analítico, curiosidade e gosta de encontrar padrões onde outros veem apenas dados, essa oportunidade é para você.

RESPONSABILIDADES

Coletar, organizar e analisar dados de diferentes fontes

Criar dashboards e relatórios para acompanhamento de performance

Identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria

Apoiar equipes de marketing, produto e negócios com insights acionáveis

Monitorar KPIs e sugerir otimizações baseadas em dados

Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados garantindo qualidade e consistência

Automatizar processos e relatórios sempre que possível

REQUISITOS

Experiência prévia como Analista de Dados ou função similar

Forte habilidade analítica e raciocínio lógico

Conhecimento em ferramentas como Excel/Google Sheets, SQL e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

Noções de estatística e interpretação de dados

Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights claros e objetivos

Organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade

DIFERENCIAIS

Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados

Conhecimento em Google Analytics, BigQuery ou ferramentas de tracking

Experiência em ambientes de marketing ou produto

BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração compatível com o mercado

Bônus por desempenho (conforme política da empresa)

Ambiente colaborativo, orientado a dados e inovação

Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: Analista de Customer Success Pleno | Produto RH
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Customer Success II para atuar na implantação (onboarding) de clientes da vertical de Capital Humano, com foco em execução de projetos, alinhamento entre stakeholders e geração de valor desde os primeiros marcos da jornada.

Essa posição será responsável por conduzir projetos de onboarding com diferentes níveis de complexidade, garantindo organização, cumprimento de prazos e qualidade na entrega, mesmo em cenários fora do fluxo padrão.

Procuramos um perfil com forte capacidade de execução, organização e relacionamento, que atue com protagonismo na condução dos projetos e tenha facilidade em navegar entre múltiplos stakeholders.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Conduzir o onboarding de clientes B2B, garantindo alinhamento de expectativas, clareza de escopo e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Estruturar e gerenciar cronogramas de implantação, acompanhando entregas, dependências e riscos ao longo da jornada;
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato do cliente durante o onboarding, garantindo comunicação clara e acompanhamento contínuo;
  • Conduzir reuniões de projeto (kickoff, checkpoints, treinamentos e follow-ups), assegurando evolução do cliente ao longo da jornada;
  • Gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, mantendo organização e priorização das demandas;
  • Identificar riscos, desvios e oportunidades de melhoria durante a execução, propondo planos de ação;
  • Monitorar indicadores de sucesso como adoção, engajamento e satisfação do cliente;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas internas (Produto, Suporte, Comercial), garantindo fluidez nas entregas;
  • Garantir registros e acompanhamento estruturado das interações e demandas dos clientes;
  • Contribuir com melhorias de processos, trazendo visão crítica e sugestões baseadas na operação.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Onboarding ou Atendimento ao Cliente B2B;
  • Vivência prática com gestão de projetos (planejamento, execução e acompanhamento de cronogramas);
  • Experiência com múltiplos stakeholders e condução de agendas estruturadas;
  • Capacidade de organização e gestão de múltiplas demandas simultâneas;
  • Boa leitura de indicadores e acompanhamento de performance do cliente;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em ferramentas como GSuite ou Pacote Office.
  • Comunicação executiva e influência;
  • Organização e capacidade de priorização;
  • Protagonismo e senso de dono;
  • Escuta ativa e construção de relacionamento;
  • Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica;
  • Maturidade para atuação em cenários de pressão e negociação;
  • Boa gestão de relacionamento com clientes e áreas internas.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

title: Vendedor(a)
description:
Estamos em busca de Vendedores(as) para atuar em concessionárias parceiras em diversas regiões do Brasil . A oportunidade é ideal para profissionais com perfil comercial, foco em resultados e interesse em crescimento no segmento de consórcios.

A contratação é realizada diretamente pela concessionária, podendo ocorrer nos modelos CLT ou PJ , e também de forma Presencial ou Hibrida, conforme a operação local, com possibilidade de ganhos escaláveis conforme performance.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar com vendas exclusivas de consórcio ;
  • Realizar atendimento presencial e digital (WhatsApp, telefone e canais online);
  • Trabalhar com leads fornecidos pela loja e realizar prospecção ativa ;
  • Apresentar e simular planos de consórcio, conduzindo o processo comercial até o fechamento;
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar o funil de vendas , garantindo follow-up e conversão;
  • Construir e manter relacionamento com clientes e parceiros internos;
  • Registrar atendimentos e vendas nos sistemas internos.

✨ Buscamos profissionais que:

  • Tenham perfil comercial e foco em resultados;
  • Gostem de atendimento ao cliente e negociação;
  • Sejam organizados, proativos e orientados a metas;
  • Queiram crescer profissionalmente no segmento de consórcios.

Vagas disponíveis em diferentes cidades e estados do Brasil.

description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Young Professional – IT Recruiter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Young Professional – IT Recruiter position focuses on launching your career in talent acquisition within a global tech company. This role involves supporting end-to-end recruitment processes and developing sourcing and interviewing skills alongside experienced recruiters. You'll participate in the full recruitment cycle from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination while building talent pipelines and collaborating with hiring teams.


Key responsibilities


- Supporting the full recruitment cycle, from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination.

- Sourcing candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, and other platforms to build a strong talent pipeline.

- Reviewing resumes and conducting initial screening calls to assess candidate profiles and interest.

- Coordinating interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a smooth experience for all parties.

- Maintaining and updating candidate records in the ATS, keeping data accurate and up to date.

- Collaborating with senior recruiters and hiring teams to understand role requirements and refine search strategies.


Requirements


- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business, or a related field — or currently pursuing one.

- Career Interest: Strong interest in IT recruitment and talent acquisition.

- Professional Attitude: Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Core Skills: Good communication and interpersonal skills.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

title: SR Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Financial Cloud
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Salesforce para atuar na personalização e automação da nossa plataforma CRM. O foco principal será o desenvolvimento de lógica de negócio robusta, escalável e integrada.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter componentes utilizando Apex (Triggers, Classes, Asynchronous Apex).
  • Criar e otimizar integrações via APIs REST/SOAP entre o Salesforce e sistemas externos.
  • Desenvolver componentes de interface (LWC ou Aura) e automações complexas (Flows).
  • Garantir a cobertura de testes unitários e a qualidade do código seguindo as melhores práticas da plataforma.
  • Colaborar com o arquiteto do COE para aplicar as regras de governança nos processos de CRM.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento na plataforma Salesforce.
  • Domínio da linguagem Apex e conhecimento de SOQL/SOSL.
  • Conhecimento em integrações e segurança de dados no Salesforce.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de deploy e versionamento (Git).
  • Experiência anterior em Financial Cloud.


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Salesforce para atuar na personalização e automação da nossa plataforma CRM. O foco principal será o desenvolvimento de lógica de negócio robusta, escalável e integrada.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter componentes utilizando Apex (Triggers, Classes, Asynchronous Apex).
  • Criar e otimizar integrações via APIs REST/SOAP entre o Salesforce e sistemas externos.
  • Desenvolver componentes de interface (LWC ou Aura) e automações complexas (Flows).
  • Garantir a cobertura de testes unitários e a qualidade do código seguindo as melhores práticas da plataforma.
  • Colaborar com o arquiteto do COE para aplicar as regras de governança nos processos de CRM.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento na plataforma Salesforce.
  • Domínio da linguagem Apex e conhecimento de SOQL/SOSL.
  • Conhecimento em integrações e segurança de dados no Salesforce.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de deploy e versionamento (Git).
  • Experiência anterior em Financial Cloud.


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.

title: CAD Software Specialist (FreeCAD/OpenSCAD /LibreCAD) - 64851
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview: We are seeking a CAD Software Specialist to create and document technical models and drawings using open-source CAD tools. The role requires strong attention to detail, structured documentation of modeling workflows, and the ability to produce export-ready technical files.


Requirements

  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken).
  • Computer with 16 GB RAM or more (mandatory).
  • Ability to operate Linux/Ubuntu in a virtual environment .
  • Proficiency in at least one of the following tools: FreeCAD or OpenSCAD.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create parametric 3D models or 2D technical drawings with proper dimensions and annotations.
  • Produce and export technical files (e.g., STEP, STL, DXF, SVG, PDF ).
  • Demonstrate design progression and parameter-driven changes through intermediate project stages.
  • Submit native project files and structured documentation explaining design intent, constraints, and workflow.


Benefits:

  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and a total of 40 hours per week with 2-4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 16 weeks
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-4 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent automated analytical challenges.
  • Once you clear them, you are ready to go!

title: Analista Linux Pleno
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Administrar, manter e evoluir ambientes Linux em produção (alta disponibilidade e missão crítica);
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado de sistemas operacionais, redes e aplicações;
  • Gerenciar servidores físicos, virtuais e ambientes em cloud HP;
  • Automatizar rotinas operacionais utilizando Shell Script, Python, ansible ou ferramentas de automação;
  • Implementar e administrar soluções de monitoramento (Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.);
  • Atuar em incidentes críticos, garantindo rápida identificação de causa raiz;
  • Aplicar hardening e boas práticas de segurança em servidores Linux Red Hat Enterprise;
  • Gerenciar patches, atualizações e ciclo de vida dos sistemas;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, redes, banco de dados e segurança;
  • Documentar procedimentos técnicos e manter base de conhecimento atualizada via Gilab e Azure DevOps.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólida experiência com administração de sistemas Linux (Red Hat, CentOS, Ubuntu, etc.);
  • Conhecimento avançado em troubleshooting (CPU, memória, I/O, rede, processos);
  • Experiência com virtualização (VMware, KVM ou similares);
  • Domínio de linha de comando e scripting (Bash, Shell Script e ansible);
  • Conhecimento em redes (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, balanceamento);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento; Munin e Zabbix.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Analista Controle da Qualidade
description:
O Grupo Zanchetta é referência nacional na Indústria e processamento de aves e bovinos.


Buscamos profissionais para compor nossa equipe de Qualidade para unidade frigorífica de Bovinos em Batayporã - MS.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar e garantir o cumprimento das normas de qualidade e segurança alimentar (BPF, APPCC/HACCP, POPs).
  • Realizar inspeções em todas as etapas do processo produtivo (abate, desossa, embalagem e expedição).
  • Verificar conformidade de matéria-prima, insumos e produto final.
  • Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas (clientes, certificadoras e órgãos reguladores).
  • Registrar e analisar não conformidades, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Controlar e atualizar documentos e registros da qualidade.
  • Apoiar na implementação e manutenção de certificações.
  • Realizar treinamentos de boas práticas e qualidade com colaboradores.
  • Monitorar indicadores de qualidade (KPIs) e propor melhorias.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade dos produtos.
  • Atuar em conjunto com produção, manutenção e logística para solução de problemas.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Engenharia de Alimentos, Medicina Veterinária, Zootecnia, Biologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em controle de qualidade no setor frigorífico bovino ou indústria de alimentos.
  • Residir em Batayporã ou Nova Andradina.

  • Verificar conformidade de matéria-prima, insumos e produto final.
  • Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas (clientes, certificadoras e órgãos reguladores).
  • Registrar e analisar não conformidades, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Controlar e atualizar documentos e registros da qualidade.
  • Apoiar na implementação e manutenção de certificações.
  • Realizar treinamentos de boas práticas e qualidade com colaboradores.
  • Monitorar indicadores de qualidade (KPIs) e propor melhorias.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade dos produtos.
  • Atuar em conjunto com produção, manutenção e logística para solução de problemas.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Engenharia de Alimentos, Medicina Veterinária, Zootecnia, Biologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em controle de qualidade no setor frigorífico bovino ou indústria de alimentos.
  • Residir em Batayporã ou Nova Andradina.

title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist
description:
About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.


One thing worth knowing

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Senior Data Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience;
  • Hands on to design, develop, and optimize our next-generation data architecture. The core of this role involves building high-performance, distributed data processing systems using Google Cloud Platform, Spark and Databricks;
  • Fluency in English (B2);
  • Williness to move to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;

  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;

  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: relocation to Portugal, mandatory.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.

title: Senior React Native Developer (Cross-Platform, Salesforce Mobile SDK)
description:
Role: Senior React Native Developer (Cross-Platform, Salesforce Mobile SDK)

Remote (Costa Rica, Brazil or Mexico)

Contract


Role Purpose


As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader You will integrate advanced capabilities like OpenCV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyperscale heavy application landscape


Key Responsibilities


• Cross Platform Development Design and develop robust mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native

• Salesforce Integration Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds

• Offline Data Management Architect Offline First capabilities using Smart Store DB Salesforce Smart Store and Smart Sync to manage complex local data persistence and synchronization

• Computer Vision Integration Implement image processing and computer vision features eg shelf scanning asset recognition or document processing using OpenCV within the mobile environment

• State Management Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit

• Experience Engineering Build high-fidelity responsive UIs that provide superior user journeys for field force users and consumers adhering to global brand standards

• Version Control CICD Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using GitHub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines

• Emerging Tech Pilots Support Digital Emerging Technology initiatives by prototyping mobile first AIML features and integrating with hyper scale hosted APIs eg GCP Vision AI

• Senior Developer Specifics Lead technical design for mobile modules perform rigorous code reviews optimize app performance memory battery and mentor junior developers in mobile best practices


Primary Skills Must-Have

• Core Framework Expertlevel proficiency in React Native JavaScript TypeScript

• Salesforce Mobile Handson experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK and Smart Store DB

• State Management Deep understanding of Redux for enterprise scale mobile apps

• Computer Vision Experience integrating OpenCV or similar C Native modules into React Native applications

• Version Control Advanced proficiency in GitHub workflows and Git based collaboration


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

• Native Modules Ability to write Native Bridges in Swift Objective C iOS or Java Kotlin Android

• Hyper scaler Exposure Experience connecting mobile apps to GCP Azure backend services Cloud Run App Services

• Salesforce Platform Familiarity with Apex SOQL and Salesforce Lightning Web Components LWC

• Mobile Security Knowledge of OAuth2 Certificate Pinning and secure local storage patterns

• FMCG Domain Understanding of retail execution van sales or field force automation workflows


Apply or send your resume to

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
About LINES


LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on us every weekend.


We're scaling fast and migrating from Firebase to a fully owned AWS backend to power real-time feeds, ticketing, and what's next.



What you'll do


  • Design backend systems for real-time, localized, event-driven timelines (Twitter/Instagram-style)
  • Architect feeds: fanout, ranking, filtering, personalization
  • Build performant APIs for mobile and web clients
  • Own features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, deployment, observability
  • Build ticketing flows: inventory, reservations, consistency, concurrency
  • Build ingestion pipelines (scrapers, cron, integrations) for the event database
  • Design data models for high-write, real-time systems
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction
  • Improve infrastructure, reliability, and developer workflows
  • Write short specs — problem, approach, tradeoffs — to move faster, not slower



What we expect


  • Strong backend fundamentals, systems-first mindset
  • Experience with feeds, timelines, ranking, fanout, or personalization
  • Solid distributed systems chops: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, tradeoffs
  • Designs for scale even when the system is still small
  • Hands-on with Redis, and knows when to reach for it
  • Experience with SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar
  • Comfortable with high-write, read-heavy workloads and eventual consistency
  • Pragmatic — ships impact, not over-engineering
  • Thrives in early-stage chaos with shifting priorities
  • Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality



Tech stack


  • Backend: NestJS (Node.js), TypeScript
  • Infra: AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare
  • Data: Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)
  • Frontend: Next.js, Expo (React Native)
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions



Nice to have


  • Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces
  • Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience
  • Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration)
  • Real-time systems (chat, live updates, video)
  • React Native or Expo

﻿

title: Coordenador de Manutenção
description:
O Grupo Zanchetta é referência nacional na Indústria e processamento de aves e bovinos.


Buscamos profissionais para compor nossa equipe de Manutenção para unidade frigorífica de Bovinos em Batayporã - MS.


  • Gestão do PCM Planejamento e controle de manutenção, CAPEX, OPEX, Indicadores e melhoria contínua.
  • Coordenar as equipes de manutenção, mecânica, elétrica, utilidades, predial e obras;
  • Atuação consolidada em preventiva e preditiva, estabelecendo metas e assegurando que os padrões de qualidade sejam alcançados.
  • Coordenar inspeções regulares para identificar potenciais problemas nos equipamentos frigoríficos e diagnosticar falhas operacionais.
  • Planejar e gerir os programas de manutenção preventiva para minimizar falhas e maximizar a vida útil dos equipamentos.
  • Coordenar chamados de manutenção emergencial, investigar problemas e promover as ações corretivas necessárias para reestabelecer as operações.
  • Atuar na segurança e conformidade, garantindo que todas as atividades de manutenção sejam executadas de acordo com as normas de segurança e ambientais
  • Manter registros precisos de todas as atividades de manutenção, incluindo relatórios de inspeção, planos de manutenção e histórico de intervenções.


Requisitos:


  • Formação Superior em Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em manutenção de frigoríficos
  • Conhecimento em manutenção Mecânica, Elétrica, Utilidades, PCM e Gestão de Processos.
  • Excel avançado.

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Software Engineer (Java/Kotlin)

Location: Brazil, Costa Rica, Colombia

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (Hourly, no benefits, candidate responsible for taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 Months (with possibility of extension)

Working Hours: 40 hours per week


Role Overview

  • Senior Software Engineer on a newly formed Item Domain team (Sales & Retail: Pricing, Pay, and Merch Tools) for an authenticated luxury resale marketplace.
  • Focus on rebuilding core item data systems (pricing, merchandising, enrichment) through a mix of greenfield development and legacy system integration.
  • This is a high-impact role contributing to a long-term transformation of core data systems, leveraging modern backend technologies and AI-assisted development.
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering leadership in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code contributing to company-wide initiatives.
  • Develop backend services and internal tooling using JVM (Java, Kotlin) as a core focus, along with existing systems in Python and Ruby.
  • Build and support web applications for shoppers and operators (listing, enrichment, merchandising).
  • Work with technologies including React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB.
  • Contribute to technical decisions shaping future software systems and architecture.
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to peers.
  • Collaborate through pair programming and support onboarding when needed.
  • Deploy user-facing code to production responsibly.
  • Partner closely with product managers, engineering leadership, and stakeholders across regions.
  • Ensure observability and reliability by learning from metrics and incidents and maintaining systems.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and engineering workflows.
  • Continuously learn and apply new technologies, patterns, and initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 3–5+ years of strong backend software engineering experience.
  • Experience with Java or another backend language, with willingness to work with Kotlin (JVM-based systems).
  • Experience building and maintaining production-ready, reliable, and secure systems.
  • Understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka).
  • Strong communication skills with product, stakeholders, and engineering peers (fluent English required ).
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with distributed and US-based teams.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, version control, and deployment tools.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with focus on user impact and business context.
  • Openness to using AI-assisted coding tools in daily development workflows.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with JVM services (Java, Kotlin) in production environments.
  • Experience with Python or Ruby.
  • Experience with web technologies: JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React.
  • Experience building microservices and working across distributed systems.
  • Experience integrating LLMs or managed AI APIs into backend or internal tools.
  • Experience with eCommerce platforms.
  • Experience working with CMS tools (especially Prismic).
  • Experience with monitoring, dashboards, and incident response in production.


What We’re Looking For

  • Backend-strong engineer (full-stack experience is a plus).
  • Adaptable and fast learner with flexibility across technologies.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving, and greenfield environments .
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborative team player.
  • Open to AI-assisted development workflows and modern engineering practices.

  • Senior Software Engineer on a newly formed Item Domain team (Sales & Retail: Pricing, Pay, and Merch Tools) for an authenticated luxury resale marketplace.

title: Gerente de Projetos de TI Sênior
description:
Sobre a WWS

Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.


Sobre a vaga

Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.

Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.
  • Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências.
  • Relacionamento com Negócio: Atuar como ponto focal para áreas de negócio (operações, logística, supply chain), traduzindo necessidades em entregas de TI.
  • Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.
  • Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em WMS.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (Cascata).
  • Capacidade de gestão de stakeholders e fornecedores externos.


Informações Adicionais

  • Regime de Contratação: PJ (pessoa jurídica)
  • Local de Trabalho: Remoto (Brasil)
  • Viagens: Pontuais (a combinar, com custos cobertos)
  • Setor da Cliente: Agronegócio (grande porte)
  • Diferencial: Vivência em projetos de cadeia de suprimentos, logística ou operações agroindustriais.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cut-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role:


The Career Framework Specialist plays a crucial role in designing and maintaining organizational talent structures, translating complex role dynamics into clear, scalable career paths. You'll bring clarity to organizational complexity by crafting intuitive job architectures that support talent growth and alignment.


Key Responsibilities:


- Designing and maintaining career paths, leveling frameworks, and job families for Talent roles.

- Building and updating role definitions, responsibilities, and seniority distinctions.

- Ensuring consistency, clarity, and scalability across all Talent-related structures.

- Partnering with Talent Acquisition Leaders to align role frameworks with business needs.

- Documenting and communicating updates in a clear, structured, and globally usable way.

- Supporting audits and Talent processes by keeping role architectures accurate and standardized.


Requirements:


- Experience: 3+ years in Organizational Development, Talent Management, HR Business Analysis, or Job Architecture.

- Design Skills: Proven experience designing career paths, job families, or role architectures.

- Analytical Ability: Strong capability to analyze and structure information into clear frameworks.

- Communication: Excellent written communication and documentation skills.

- Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional HR or Talent teams.

- Technical Skills: Advanced experience with Excel/Google Sheets and documentation tools.


Desired Tools Experience:


- Documentation platforms like Notion or Confluence.

- Flowchart/mapping tools such as Miro or Lucidchart.


Personal Attributes:


- Systems and structural thinking.

- Passion for clarity and logical problem-solving.

- Ability to translate complex information into intuitive frameworks.

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

- Skill in collaborating across multiple stakeholders.

- Elite Collaboration: Work with the global top 1% of talent.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.
