title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 

Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:

O Grupo Capital:

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 

Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 

Pré-requisitos:

  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Diferencial:

  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

Você terá:

  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

Modo de contratação:

  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Especialista Fullstack Sênior (Go/React)
description:
Qual será o seu papel?

  • Participar do time Core de plataforma.
  • Pesquisar novas tecnologias.
  • Realizar experimentos.
  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades.
  • Desenvolver melhorias nas funcionalidades já existentes.
  • Elaborar e executar POCs.
  • Auxiliar no processo de homologação.
  • Elaborar documentação técnica.

Esperamos que você:

  • Sólida experiência com Golang no desenvolvimento de aplicações backend escaláveis e de alta performance
  • Experiência com React e Next.js para construção de interfaces modernas, performáticas e orientadas a componentes
  • Conhecimento em renderização SSR/SSG, roteamento e otimização de performance no frontend
  • Domínio de boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo Design Patterns e princípios SOLID
  • Vivência com arquiteturas modernas (microsserviços, event-driven, DDD, arquitetura hexagonal / clean architecture)
  • Experiência com integração entre sistemas (APIs REST, mensageria, streaming de eventos)
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ ou similares)
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL)
  • Familiaridade com Cloud (preferencialmente GCP)
  • Experiência com containerização e DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD – ex: GitLab CI)
  • Domínio de Git e boas práticas de versionamento
  • Forte preocupação com qualidade de código, testes automatizados e observabilidade
  • Experiência com sistemas de missão crítica (alta disponibilidade, resiliência, performance)
  • Experiência com observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing)
  • Participação ativa em decisões de arquitetura
  • Perfil hands-on, com visão de produto
  • Vivência com práticas ágeis e colaboração com times multidisciplinares
  • +4 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software
  • Formação em Computação, Engenharias, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas (desejável)

Diferencial importante:

  • Experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA como Cursor para aumento de produtividade
  • Capacidade de aplicar IA para:
  • geração e revisão de código
  • automação de testes
  • troubleshooting e análise de logs
  • Familiaridade de integração com APIs de IA generativa (LLMs)
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de agentes
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Python
  • Interesse em evoluir para um modelo de desenvolvimento AI-assisted / AI-first

title: Software Engineer
description:

• JavaScript / TypeScript

Oportunidade em uma das maiores operadoras de Saúde do Brasil!

  • Domínio de arquitetura de software, design patterns e clean code.

  • Experiência com TypeScript.
  • Conhecimento em Next.js.
  • Vivência com Microsserviços e mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ etc.).
  • Experiência com pipelines CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (Jest, Cypress).
  • Familiaridade com Docker e computação em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).

Horário: 8h às 18h (segunda a sexta) — 1h12 de intervalo

Equipamento: Necessário utilizar máquina própria

Atuação:

1x na semana presencial

title: Young Professional - IT Recruiter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role

The Young Professional – IT Recruiter position focuses on launching your career in talent acquisition within a global tech company. This role involves supporting end-to-end recruitment processes and developing sourcing and interviewing skills alongside experienced recruiters. You'll participate in the full recruitment cycle from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination while building talent pipelines and collaborating with hiring teams.

Key responsibilities

- Supporting the full recruitment cycle, from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination.

- Sourcing candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, and other platforms to build a strong talent pipeline.

- Reviewing resumes and conducting initial screening calls to assess candidate profiles and interest.

- Coordinating interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a smooth experience for all parties.

- Maintaining and updating candidate records in the ATS, keeping data accurate and up to date.

- Collaborating with senior recruiters and hiring teams to understand role requirements and refine search strategies.

Requirements

- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business, or a related field — or currently pursuing one.

- Career Interest: Strong interest in IT recruitment and talent acquisition.

- Professional Attitude: Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Core Skills: Good communication and interpersonal skills.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.

Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID 121504
description:
Sobre a vaga

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.

O que estamos buscando?

Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID

Requisitos:

Esse vaga precisa de inglês Avançado . VAGA COM INGLÊS FLUENTE Engenheiro de dados Gestão de estruturas de dados, definição de modelos e padrões logidos de dados como unica fonte de informação (data lake com governança de dados ); Experiencia em arquitetura de Dados; Desenvolvimento Python; Experiencia em coleta, transformação e carga de dados (ferramentas de ETL ); Experiência em trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados; Modelagem de Banco de Dados (SQL, Hadoop, MySQL, Redshift, ); Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB ); Integração de dados com outros sistemas Plataforma AWS; Experiência em workloads de missão crítica; Containers (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, EKS Openshift); DevOps (Gitlab; Gitlab CI, Puppet); Cloudformation (Code Build, CodePipeline) Softwares Necessários: API Gateway . title: AEM Backend Developer
description:
GUT is an award-winning global creative network powered by Globant . We bring together creativity, technology, and AI to shape the future of marketing, partnering with leading global brands to create ideas that move people and drive business growth. With a diverse and passionate team across multiple countries, we’re redefining how creativity and innovation work together to transform the industry, one brave idea at a time.


We seek an AEM Backend Develope r who dares to think differently and trusts their gut .

You’ll play a key role in crafting ideas that move culture and drive business, blending creativity, media, and AI to make an impact that lasts.


What will help you succeed:

  • Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) with a focus on backend development
  • Proficiency in Java and OSGi/Felix framework for building AEM components, services, and workflows
  • Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating AEM with third-party systems


This job can be filled in any city within Brazil, as a mostly remote job con ocassional domestic traveling.


*GUT is a business unit within Globant, operating as its creative and marketing division. All services are provided within the framework of Globant’s corporate governance, policies, and legal entities, as applicable in each jurisdiction.

title: Coordenador Administrativo
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coordenar as atividades administrativas e assegurar a qualidade dos serviços prestados, bem como o desempenho da equipe; Coordenar a aprimoração do tempo de execução das tarefas, visando dar maior velocidade ao fluxo de informações; Identificar necessidades de melhorias nos processos administrativos, propondo planos de ações para melhoria da eficácia; Coordenar, organizar e motivar a equipe, visando alcançar níveis crescentes de produtividade; Coordenar as equipes de limpeza, portaria e recepção, certificando-se de que os serviços estão sendo executados com qualidade; Participar no processo de recrutamento e seleção de profissionais da área; Participar na definição de programas de treinamento e reciclagem profissional de sua equipe; Elaborar relatórios de informações gerenciais solicitados pela gerência / diretoria; Participar na definição de programas de treinamento e reciclagem profissional de sua equipe quando necessário; Participar no processo de recrutamento e seleção de profissionais da área quando necessário; Manter os equipamentos de trabalho em perfeito estado de conservação e limpeza; Cumprir normas e procedimentos da empresa, referentes a área de atuação; Conduzir veículo que serão utilizados para atividade de maneira eficiente e segura; Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de saúde, segurança do trabalho e utilizar adequadamente equipamentos de proteção individual e coletiva; Comprometer-se com as áreas: Gestão da Qualidade, Meio Ambiente e Segurança do Trabalho; Executar outras tarefas correlatas às descritas acima a critério da organização, de acordo com orientação do superior imediato.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo
  • Conhecimento Pacote Office
  • CNH B


Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 25.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência, previsibilidade e escala para operações de todos os portes.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

No cargo de Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção , você terá papel fundamental na construção e evolução do time do Clínica Experts, sendo responsável por atrair, identificar e selecionar talentos alinhados à estratégia e à cultura da empresa. Buscamos uma pessoa com olhar analítico e senso de dono, capaz de conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta com qualidade, agilidade e foco na experiência do candidato e dos gestores. Você será um elo estratégico entre as áreas de negócio e o time de Pessoas, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento sustentável da empresa por meio da formação de times de alta performance.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir processos seletivos end-to-end, desde o alinhamento de perfil com gestores até a proposta final ao candidato;
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) das lideranças, apoiando na definição de perfil, mapeamento de competências e estratégias de contratação;
  • Realizar triagem de currículos, hunting ativo e abordagem de candidatos em diferentes canais (LinkedIn, bancos de talentos, indicações, entre outros);
  • Conduzir entrevistas por competências, avaliando aspectos técnicos e comportamentais dos candidatos;
  • Garantir uma excelente experiência para candidatos ao longo de toda a jornada seletiva;
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar indicadores de recrutamento (tempo de contratação, taxa de conversão, qualidade de contratação, entre outros);
  • Apoiar na estruturação e melhoria contínua dos processos e ferramentas de recrutamento e seleção;
  • Atuar na organização e fortalecimento da marca empregadora (employer branding), contribuindo com ações e iniciativas de atração de talentos;
  • Manter o ATS e demais ferramentas atualizadas com informações dos processos seletivos;
  • Apoiar iniciativas estratégicas da área de Pessoas, quando necessário.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Formação em andamento ou concluída em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com recrutamento e seleção, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia ou ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Vivência com condução de processos seletivos completos e entrevistas por competências;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de hunting e uso de ferramentas como LinkedIn Recruiter (ou similares);
  • Boa capacidade analítica e organização para gestão de múltiplas vagas simultaneamente;
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Habilidade de relacionamento com diferentes níveis da organização;
  • Perfil proativo, orientado a resultados e com senso de urgência.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com recrutamento para áreas de tecnologia, produto ou comercial;
  • Vivência em startups ou empresas de alto crescimento;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de RH e People Analytics;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de ATS, preferencialmente Inhire ou similares;

Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Plano de Saúde Ambulatorial (Unimed) + Plano Odontológico (Uniodonto);
  • Wellhub (Gympass) — acesso a academias, estúdios e atividades físicas; ️‍♂️
  • Guia da Alma — plataforma de terapia online e bem-estar emocional;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida; ️
  • Conexão Premiada — programa de incentivo por indicação de talentos;
  • Ambiente inspirador, com foco em desenvolvimento e alta performance!

Vaga 100% presencial em Lajeado/RS.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por pessoas, tem olhar estratégico para talentos e gosta de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e em crescimento acelerado, queremos conhecer você!

Venha fazer parte da construção de times que estão transformando a gestão em saúde no Brasil ✨

title: SAP OTC Functional Consultant Sr.
description:
Senior SAP OTC Functional Consultant (Mexico & Brazil Only)

We’re not looking for someone to “support SAP.”

We’re looking for someone who owns Order-to-Cash end-to-end and knows how to keep it running under pressure.

If you’ve worked in complex SAP environments (S/4HANA + ECC) , handled real business impact, and can step in without hand-holding—keep reading.

Location: Mexico or Brazil (mandatory)

What You’ll Be Driving

You’ll take full ownership of the Order-to-Cash (O2C) process , ensuring stability, performance, and continuous improvement across the SAP ecosystem.

  • Run and optimize SAP SD processes end-to-end (orders → delivery → billing)
  • Handle pricing, credit checks, ATP, and output without friction
  • Keep integrations with MM, WM, FI and external systems working seamlessly
  • Step in fast when issues hit production— and solve them properly

Where You’ll Make the Difference

This is not a passive role. You’ll be expected to:

  • Challenge and refine business requirements—not just document them
  • Translate needs into clear, executable functional specs
  • Work closely with technical teams to deliver solutions that actually work
  • Lead testing cycles (UAT, regression, impact analysis) with zero surprises
  • Drive user adoption , training, and continuous improvement

What Sets You Apart

  • You’ve already operated as a Senior SAP SD / OTC Consultant
  • You understand the full O2C lifecycle , not just parts of it
  • You’re comfortable with integrations, EDI, and legacy systems
  • You don’t wait for instructions—you take ownership and move things forward
  • You communicate clearly with both business and technical teams

Why This Role

  • Exposure to S/4HANA rollout and transformation projects
  • High visibility across business and IT stakeholders
  • A role where your decisions actually impact operations

If you’re used to stepping into complex environments and making them work—

this is where you prove it.

title: Consultor(a) Comercial
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

O Clínica Experts está em busca de novos talentos para o nosso Time Comercial!

No cargo de Consultor(a) Comercial , você será responsável por oferecer soluções personalizadas aos nossos clientes, garantindo sua satisfação e sucesso nas conversões. Você aplicará técnicas de atendimento consultivo, gerenciará leads qualificados e trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe para ajustar os métodos de atendimento conforme as necessidades do cliente.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Administrar leads qualificados, realizando demonstrações com soluções de forma eficiente;
  • Empregar técnicas persuasivas de atendimento consultivo e estratégias de negociação para alcançar as taxas de sucesso nas conversões;
  • Oferecer feedback ativo ao time de marketing e suporte ao cliente, refletindo as experiências com clientes e as tendências observadas no mercado;
  • Implementar táticas de atendimento personalizada, gerenciando os ciclos de atendimento com eficácia;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe para compreender as necessidades dos clientes e adaptar métodos de atendimento sob medida;
  • Conduzir apresentações de alto nível e negociações importantes, assegurando êxito em operações críticas.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Técnicas de atendimento ao cliente.

Diferencial:

Vivência com atendimento ao cliente, atendimento por ligações e videochamadas.

Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Plano de Saúde Ambulatorial (Unimed) + Plano Odontológico (Uniodonto);
  • Wellhub (Gympass) — acesso a academias, estúdios e atividades físicas; ️‍♂️
  • Guia da Alma — plataforma de terapia online e bem-estar emocional, com diversos profissionais de saúde mental;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida; ️
  • Conexão Premiada — programa de incentivo por indicação de talentos;
  • Ambiente inspirador, com foco em desenvolvimento e alta performance!

Vaga 100% presencial para a cidade de Lajeado/RS.

Se você é comunicativo(a), proativo(a) e tem facilidade em entender as necessidades dos clientes, queremos te conhecer! Buscamos pessoas com vontade de aprender e atuar em vendas consultivas, oferecendo soluções tecnológicas que transformam a gestão em saúde.

Venha fazer parte do nosso Time!

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.


What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.


Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Data Software Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 20-25/hr USD.


Role Details:


We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties.
  • Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services.
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores.
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management.
  • Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.


Qualifications: What you bring to the team


You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences.
  • Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js.
  • Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services.
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps).
  • Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility.
  • BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.


You might also have:

  • Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience.
  • AWS Certifications.
  • Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus).
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation.
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture.
  • Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring.
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming.

title: SAP Consultant
description:
Type: Contract

Location: Fully Remote in Brazil

Rate: $30/hr USD - $40/HR USD




JOB DESCRIPTION


Insight Global is seeking an experienced SAP Consultant, D2B EPPM to support an SAP S/4HANA implementation for a client in the oil and gas sector. This is a contract until the end of 2026, with a strong possibility of extension. The candidate must work in alignment with AST time zone.

The ideal candidate will have proven SAP PPM implementation skills in data conversion, financial planning, decision points and workflows, as well as, SAP PPM bidirectional integration with PS.


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE


- 5 years SAP Functional Consultant

- SAP PPM (Enterprise Portfolio & Project Management) implementation experience in data conversion, financial planning, decision points & workflow configuration

- Bi directional integration between SAP PPM and SAP PS for budgeting, forecasting and actuals tracking

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- SAP PS implementation experience

- Integration experience with Finance (FI/CO), EAM, SCM, and Controlling

title: MES Developer
description:
MES Developer

Brazil/Argentina

Contract

Key Accountabilities:

  • This role will provide you with the opportunity to lead key activities to make progress in your career, these responsibilities include some of the following:
  • Participate in requirements gathering to solidify requirements and determine the best technical solution to meet the business needs.
  • Develop and implement new templates, components, and responsive web pages/sites and support client development and security standards while developing.
  • Work in the Manufacturing organization on the implementation of new capabilities.
  • Carry out the development of the assigned project adhering to the engineering standards/best practices, committing to the agreed timeline, and ensures quality metrics are met.
  • Integrate internal and/or external applications/ERP using middleware.

Key Qualifications and Experience

We are seeking an experienced Developer with strong expertise in GE Plant Applications to design, develop, enhance, and support Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with SQL, .NET technologies, and Web Services, and will work closely with manufacturing, quality, and other cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and scalable design to enhance current MES/Quality solutions that support shop-floor operations.

  • Strong hands-on experience with GE Plant Applications.
  • Proficiency in writing Stored procedure, Functions and other SQL Server related codes. (T-SQL, performance tuning, database design)
  • Experience with .NET technologies (C#, ASP.NET, Web API, Windows Services)
  • Solid understanding of Web Services (REST and/or SOAP)
  • Experience with UI design – HTML/Thingworx/ReactJS
  • Strong hands-on experience with reporting capabilities – SSRS/PBI and others.
  • Experience integrating MES with ERP systems (SAP preferred)
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and shop-floor systems
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams
  • Experience designing and optimizing relational databases and stored procedures for optimal performance and/or maintainability.
  • Experience with version control systems (Azure DevOps preferably)
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

title: Engenheiro de Software (Java) - Sênior
description:
Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.

What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.

About the Client

This position will support one of our clients, a global company focused in retail.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborates and pairs with other product team members (UX, engineering, and product management) to create secure, reliable, scalable software solutions
  • Writes custom code or scripts to automate infrastructure, monitoring services, and test cases
  • Writes custom code or scripts to do \"destructive testing\" to ensure adequate resiliency in production
  • Creates meaningful dashboards, logging, alerting, and responses to ensure that issues are captured and addressed proactively
  • Contributes to enterprise-wide tools to drive destructive testing, automation, or engineering empowerment
  • Identifies product enhancements (client-facing or technical) to create a better experience for the end users
  • Identifies unsecured code areas and implements fixes as they are discovered with or without tooling
  • Contributes to foundational code elements that can be reused many times by a product
  • Contributes to meaningful architecture diagrams and other documentation needed for security reviews or other interested parties
  • Defines Service Level Objectives for product(s) to constantly measure their reliability in production and help prioritize backlog work

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience with Java 11 or above
  • Experience and understanding of what Lambda Expressions and Streams are in Java 8
  • SQL experience (BigQuery)
  • Understanding of ML concepts
  • Experience using Spring Boot
  • Must have experience developing microservices with Spring Boot
  • Experience developing applications that are hosted in the cloud – Home Depot uses GPC, but open to AWS or Azure experience
  • Experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience writing Junit test cases
  • 2+ years’ experience working in an Agile environment in 2 week sprints
  • Advanced English required

Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• CLT hiring model + benefits

• International team environment

title: Gestor de Tráfego Pago - Junior / Pleno
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Somos um e-commerce de moda íntima feminina com 7anos de mercado. Investimento médio de 400-500k mês em mídia paga e faturamento de 8D ano.

Principais Atividades desempenhadas

  • Planejamento de Campanhas: Desenvolver estratégias de campanhas em plataformas de anúncios, alinhadas com os objetivos de marketing e vendas da empresa.
  • Automações com IA.
  • Execução de Campanhas: Criar, configurar e lançar campanhas de publicidade nas plataformas Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram), TikTok Ads e Pinterest Ads.
  • Realização de Testes A/B.
  • Subir testes de criativos semanalmente.
  • Fazer controle de Gastos Previsto x Realizado da Marca.
  • Pesquisa de Palavras Chaves e Segmentação.
  • Reuniões Semanais e Alinhamentos com a equipe de Marketing: Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de criação, conteúdo, para alinhar as estratégias e garantir coesão nas campanhas.
  • Realizar analise de contas e entregar relatórios de performance semanalmente e mensalmente.
  • Configuração de Pixel, tags de traqueamento e GTM se for necessário.

description:

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor Frontend Sênior para atuar em melhorias, novos projetos e sustentação do dia a dia do cliente , com foco em performance, qualidade e padronização .

Stack / Conhecimentos esperados:

  • React (Hooks, Context API, Redux/Redux Toolkit )
  • Next.js
  • JavaScript (ES6+) e TypeScript
  • Integração com APIs RESTful
  • Estilização com Material UI / Styled Components / Tailwind CSS
  • Testes com Jest e React Testing Library
  • Experiência com SPA e PWA
  • Docker / Docker Compose e noções de Kubernetes

  • Contribuir para padronização (boas práticas, arquitetura, componentes, guidelines)
  • Integrar interfaces com APIs REST e atuar em aplicações modernas (SPA/PWA)

O que valorizamos (soft skill)

  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas
  • Organização , atenção à qualidade e entrega
  • Comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e de negócio
  • Colaboração em ambiente multidisciplinar
  • Autonomia com senso de responsabilidade e melhoria contínua

title: Supply Plannig specialist
description:
Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin: Where purpose comes to life.

You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose ‘to advance life around the world’ drives our entire global team.

Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we work for. How about you?

At Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin), we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments. And where is our help most needed? The places we live in: cities where drinking water is leaking away, greenery is disappearing, streets are flooding after heavy rain, and outdated sewer systems are polluting our groundwater. It’s time to join our team and help build more sustainable environments!

We are currently looking for a Supply Plannig Specialist to join us at Sumaré, Brazil . If you want to make a difference and work for a purpose-led company, please read on.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze medium- and long-term capacity (6 months to 5 years).
  • Develop footprint scenarios and plant capacity balance.
  • Identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks, and future needs.
  • Support investment decisions, prioritization, and capacity allocation.
  • Prepare budgets related to capacity and operations.
  • Create and maintain scenarios in SAP IBP, applying best practices.
  • Support S&OP planning cycles with structured analyses and recommendations
  • Provide support to S&OP and S&OE teams by working in a stewardship role.
  • Drive inventory optimization initiatives linked to cost and service.
  • Migrate reports to Power BI and build executive-level dashboards with reliable data.
  • Promote continuous improvement through automation, AI, and process standardization.

Profile:

  • The ideal candidate will have a strong background project management, planning process improvement , or planning system implementation.
  • Solid knowledge and hands-on experience with SAP IBP and Power BI is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.
  • 5 years of experience as a Supply Planning Specialist or Senior Supply Planning Analyst within the manufacturing or logistics industry.

*Please attach your Cv in English

What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers

Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B&I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.

Organization

Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it’s to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B&I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B&I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.

Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred

Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.

As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor.


Perfil desejado

Buscamos uma liderança técnica com alta autonomia e visão sistêmica. Você não apenas escreve código de excelência, mas atua como um multiplicador, influenciando o roadmap técnico e garantindo que nossas soluções sejam resilientes e seguras por padrão.

Você deve ser um entusiasta da eficiência, utilizando ferramentas de IA e agentes para acelerar o ciclo de desenvolvimento, permitindo que seu foco esteja na resolução de problemas complexos de arquitetura e estratégia de dados.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderança de Arquitetura: Guiar a concepção e evolução da plataforma Audit Copilot, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e rastreabilidade em todo o ecossistema.
  • Impacto Cross-Team: Atuar além do próprio time, identificando dependências, mitigando riscos técnicos e garantindo que as integrações com os times de Dados sejam fluidas e performáticas.
  • Excelência Operacional: Definir e zelar por padrões de confiabilidade (SLOs) e observabilidade, transformando aprendizados de incidentes em melhorias sistêmicas para reduzir o toil.
  • Mentoria e Cultura: Elevar a barra técnica da Arvo, mentorando engenheiros, promovendo revisões de design críticas e disseminando boas práticas (TDD, CI/CD, Clean Architecture).
  • Parceria Estratégica: Colaborar com Produto para refinar o escopo técnico de iniciativas ambíguas, equilibrando trade-offs entre velocidade de entrega e dívida técnica.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em engenharia de computação ou ciência da computação ou possuir experiência prática nessas áreas
  • 7+ anos de experiência com desenvolvimento e arquitetura de software
  • Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura e boas práticas de código tais como SOLID, Clean Code Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, Layered Architecture, etc.
  • Experiência com algum cloud provider (GCP, AWS, Azure, etc.)
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Postgres) e não relacionais (Redis)
  • Uso de ferramentas e agentes de IA (ex: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, LLMs para automação) para agilizar a codificação, testes e documentação.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência com pipeline de processamento de dados
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Go e Python
  • Experiência com terraform e IaC, Kubernetes (recursos básicos, kubectl)
  • Experiência com GCP


Benefícios (modelo de contratação PJ)

  • 13º salário: proporcional aos meses trabalhados no ano
  • Férias remuneradas: 22 dias úteis
  • 1/3 adicional de férias
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco Saúde Nacional II (TNMI)
  • VA/VR: R$1.080 no Flash
  • Acesso ao wellhub (gympass)
  • Vaga remota

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping.


As part of Zoolatech’s distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery.


By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity.


Responsibilities


  • Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems
  • Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang
  • Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation
  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams
  • Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly
  • Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies
  • Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture


Skills Required

  • Strong commercial experience with Golang
  • Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS
  • Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services
  • Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills
  • Good communication skills and ability to work independently
  • English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python
  • Familiarity with MongoDB, Elasticsearch, GraphQL, or JVM languages
  • Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)

This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.

To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.

Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for a detail-oriented Accountant to support our client with day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, and reconciliation processes within NetSuite. If you have strong experience managing financial data, ensuring accuracy across accounts, and working within a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes within NetSuite
  • Prepare and record journal entries, including accruals and adjustments
  • Perform bank and credit card reconciliations and resolve discrepancies
  • Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts to ensure accuracy
  • Support month-end and year-end close processes
  • Generate financial reports and assist with basic financial analysis
  • Review transactions for accuracy, completeness, and compliance
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify financial data and resolve issues
  • Ensure financial records are organized, accurate, and audit-ready within NetSuite


Who We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Minimum 3+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience supporting US-based clients or working in a BPO/outsourcing environment is preferred
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite and proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 1,200 - 1,600 , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Arquiteto Corporativo Líder
description:
*Vaga Kaspper: Arquiteto Corporativo Líder – Core Bancário*

Sobre a vaga*

*Cliente: na área financeira

*Local: Full-time / Modelo Hibrido / Disponibilidade para viagens para Belém do - PA ou Residir nas proximidades/ 02 semanas em Belém do PA / 02 Remoto e assim sucessivamente. Após isso a vaga será 100% remota. Caso o profissional não seja de Belém do PA ... Arcaremos com a viagem, Alimentação, hospedagem e deslocamento.

**Projeto com a Kaspper de 90 dias. Após esse período Há a possibilidade de ser absorvido diretamente pelo cliente, de acordo com o desempenho do profissional no projeto e negociação feita diretamente entre o cliente e o profissional, mas não há a garantia.

*Quem somos nós*

Aqui na Kaspper, a gente leva tecnologia a sério, mas sem perder a leveza!

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia feita de pessoas incríveis, criando soluções personalizadas para que nossos clientes respirem tranquilidade.

Há mais de 30 anos, entregamos projetos desafiadores para grandes empresas como Santander, Bayer, Banco do Nordeste, Whirlpool, Brinks, Mapfre, Safra, PwC, entre outras. ✨

Saiba mais:

*Sobre a vaga*

*Cliente: Banco da Amazônia (BASA)

*Projeto: 90 dias (com possibilidade de extensão ou absorção pelo cliente)

*Responsabilidades*

Atuar como Arquiteto Corporativo Líder na implantação da Plataforma Central de Processamento Bancário (Core Bancário).

Liderar decisões arquiteturais críticas em ambiente regulado pelo BACEN.

Coordenar múltiplos fornecedores técnicos em um consórcio complexo.

Definir, formalizar e garantir contratos de integração entre sistemas (IDM/APIs).

Atuar diretamente com stakeholders regulatórios e executivos (DIREX).

Conduzir governança arquitetural (ARB, ADRs, KPIs e decisões estratégicas).

Atuar em cenários críticos, incluindo gestão de crise e modo emergencial.

Garantir aderência a padrões de integração, segurança, compliance e arquitetura corporativa.

Integrar soluções garantindo uma entrega harmônica e com visão de conjunto (end-to-end).

Atuar de forma consultiva junto ao cliente, trazendo dores, riscos e propondo soluções de forma estruturada.

️ *Requisitos Técnicos*

(Importante: não precisa dominar 100% de todas as disciplinas, mas é essencial ter boa compreensão e vivência prática no ecossistema)

*Core Banking & Regulatório (ESSENCIAL)*

Experiência sólida em projetos com bancos regulados pelo BACEN.

Domínio do ecossistema de pagamentos (PIX, TED, STR, DDA, boletos, CIP, COMPE).

Conhecimento de regulatórios: Open Finance, SISBAJUD, CADOCs, CCS, BACEN.

Experiência com Core Bancário (Temenos, Mambu, Finacle, Corebanx ou similares).

Conhecimento contábil bancário (COSIF, partidas dobradas, integração ERP).

Vivência com AML/KYC/PLD (COAF e BACEN).

*Arquitetura de Integração (CRÍTICO)*

Domínio em APIs REST (boas práticas, versionamento, segurança OAuth2/JWT).

Forte experiência com mensageria (Kafka, IBM MQ, AMQ, filas e DLQ).

Experiência com Interface Dependency Management (IDM).

Conhecimento em padrões EIP (event-driven, CQRS, Saga, retry/backoff).

Protocolos financeiros: ISO 8583, ISO 20022, CNAB, Connect Direct.

*Stack Tecnológico*

OpenShift/Kubernetes (deploy, autoscaling, CI/CD).

Java + Spring Boot (microserviços, segurança, integrações).

Oracle 19c (RAC, JDBC, padrões de dados).

Ferramentas de segurança: IAM, Keycloak, HSM, PAM.

Observabilidade: Grafana, Dynatrace, Zabbix, SonarQube.

Data & Analytics: Oracle Analytics, GoldenGate, Data Lake.

*Governança Arquitetural*

Experiência com ARB (Architecture Review Board).

Produção de ADRs estruturados.

Conhecimento em frameworks (TOGAF, C4 ou ArchiMate).

Gestão de dívida técnica e KPIs arquiteturais.

Capacidade de conduzir modo emergencial em projetos críticos.

*Gestão de Fornecedores*

Experiência coordenando múltiplos fornecedores simultaneamente.

Onboarding técnico acelerado de parceiros.

Gestão de conflitos técnicos entre fornecedores.

title: Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing.

You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle.
  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications.
  • System Optimization: Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems.
  • Complex Integrations: Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.
  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Ruby on Rails Mastery: 12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework.
  • Advanced API Expertise: Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale.
  • Testing & CI/CD: Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery).
  • Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp.
  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

title: Analista de Automação Pleno (Cypress)
description:
Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!


#VemSerVericoder


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Diagnosticar e corrigir problemas em scripts de testes automatizados;
  • Elaborar cenários de testes;
  • Documentar e revisar a documentação de projetos de testes automatizados;
  • Identificar e registrar defeitos encontrados durante os testes;
  • Gerar evidências claras e precisas dos resultados de teste;
  • Reportar o status das execuções, identificar defeitos e comunicar impedimentos.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida em programação com JavaScript;
  • Proficiência no uso do Cypress para automação de testes;
  • Proficiência em Bruno APIClient ou Postman;
  • Conhecimento prático em Cucumber para desenvolvimento orientado por comportamento (BDD);
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência no trabalho com bancos de dados e SQL;
  • Domínio de BDD para criação de testes automatizados baseados em comportamento.


Benefícios:

Reembolso de Capacitações Técnicas: Cobertura de 100% para certificações profissionais, além de reembolso para cursos de capacitação técnica;

title: AI Video Producer (VEO3) for YouTube Ad Creative Agency
description:
About Us

We are a performance driven YouTube ad creative agency focused on producing high converting video ads for ecommerce brands.

Our team combines direct response strategy with cutting edge AI production workflows to create scalable video assets that drive measurable results.

We move fast, test aggressively, and continuously iterate on creative performance. Our focus is not on aesthetics alone, but on producing video content that converts and scales profitably.

We operate as a small, high performance team built around speed, ownership, and results.


Role Overview

We are hiring an AI Video Producer who specializes in generating high quality video content using AI tools such as VEO3, Kling, Heygen, and similar platforms.

You will be responsible for translating creative briefs into raw video assets by crafting effective prompts, iterating on outputs, and delivering production ready footage for our YouTube ad campaigns.

This role requires strong prompting skills, creative intuition, and the ability to consistently produce high quality outputs at scale.

You will work closely with creative strategists, editors, and AI workflows to bring ad concepts to life efficiently.


Key Responsibilities

Craft high quality prompts for VEO3, Kling, Heygen, and similar AI video tools to generate compelling video clips.

Produce raw video footage that aligns with creative briefs and direct response messaging.

Iterate on AI generated outputs to refine quality, consistency, and performance.

Translate written scripts and concepts into visual scenes using AI tools.

Collaborate with creative strategists and editors to ensure alignment on direction and deliverables.

Stay up to date with the latest AI video tools, prompting techniques, and workflows.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality.

Optimize workflows to increase output efficiency and scalability.


Qualifications and Requirements

Experience using AI video tools such as VEO, Kling, Heygen, Runway, or similar.

Strong prompting ability with a clear understanding of how to control output quality and style.

Good visual sense and understanding of storytelling, pacing, and scene composition.

Ability to follow creative briefs and translate them into accurate visual outputs.

Experience working in a fast paced, performance driven environment.

Highly self directed with strong attention to detail.

Comfortable working with iterative workflows and rapid testing cycles.

Basic understanding of direct response marketing is a strong advantage.


Preferred Skills and Bonuses

Experience producing video creatives for YouTube or paid social ads.

Understanding of direct response frameworks and ad structures.

Experience working with ecommerce brands.

Familiarity with AI workflow automation and tools.

Experience collaborating with editors and creative teams.


What We Offer

Fully remote position.

Consistent workload with ongoing projects.

Opportunity to work with cutting edge AI tools.

Fast paced environment with rapid learning.

Clear growth path as the agency scales.

Performance driven culture focused on output and results.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst

Location: Remote (Brazil)

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.

What You'll Do:

  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Administrador de Dados (SAP S/4HANA | Integração)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Administrador(a) de Dados Sênior / Especialista para atuar em um projeto estratégico de implementação SAP S/4HANA , com foco em modelagem e integração de dados .

Modelo de atuação: 100% remoto

Contratação PJ

Responsabilidades

  • Elaborar modelos de dados conceitual, lógico e físico
  • Evoluir e detalhar data mappings (RICEFW)
  • Mapear e estruturar dados de sistemas legados (Java) para SAP S/4
  • Definir padrões de dados, nomenclatura/taxonomia e domínios
  • Garantir integridade, consistência e rastreabilidade ponta a ponta
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento, integração e arquitetura SAP
  • Criar e manter dicionário de dados, modelos ER e documentação técnica
  • Definir regras de qualidade, validação e reconciliação de dados
  • Identificar gaps de modelagem e propor melhorias

Requisitos

  • Experiência como Administrador ou Modelador de Dados
  • Domínio de modelagem de dados conceitual, lógica e física
  • SQL avançado
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas e data mapping (source → target)
  • Vivência com sistemas legados
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais (Oracle, SQL Server, entre outros)
  • Atuação com governança e qualidade de dados
  • Experiência com ferramentas de modelagem (ERwin, PowerDesigner ou similares)

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em projetos SAP S/4HANA
  • Conhecimento em RICEFW
  • Experiência com integrações SAP (APIs, CPI, PI/PO)
  • Vivência em migração ou transformação de sistemas
  • Experiência com MDM (Master Data Management)

Perfil

  • Perfil analítico e estruturado
  • Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas e de negócio
  • Capacidade de traduzir regras de negócio em modelo de dados
  • Organização e disciplina na documentação

Contexto do projeto

  • Implementação SAP S/4HANA
  • Data mappings já iniciados
  • Foco atual em modelagem e estruturação de dados para integração
